sources.title: Calibrate-Then-Act: Cost-Aware Exploration in LLM Agents
sources.verified: CTA explicitly conditions decisions on estimated priors. Its coding task infers three latent CSV formatting attributes. UNIT_TEST reveals one true attribute; CODE executes a proposed configuration. Reward discounts correctness multiplicatively for tests and code attempts. FileReading has 1,400 training, 300 validation and 300 test tasks; four relative-cost settings reuse each task. A filename predictor supplies priors to Qwen3-8B, with prompted and RL comparisons.
sources.inference_for_our_goal: Prospective cost-aware information acquisition is prior art. A possible contribution requires real failed patches, imperfect observable diagnostics and measured deployment resource envelopes; changing the domain alone does not establish novelty. A calibrated prior/value comparator belongs in a future protocol, not in this live solver control.

sources.title: Rethinking the Value of Agent-Generated Tests for LLM-Based Software Engineering Agents
sources.status: arXiv v1 preprint, 2026-02-08; venue/DOI placeholders are not publication evidence
sources.verified: The study analyzes six models on SWE-bench Verified and changes test-writing instructions for four. Table 7 reports GPT-5.2 at 359/500 resolutions both before and after encouragement, with average calls rising 19.76 to 20.84. Discouragement reduces Kimi calls 46.82 to 30.25 and resolutions 317 to 304; DeepSeek calls 46.40 to 35.06 and resolutions 300 to 291.
sources.inference_for_our_goal: Prompt interventions alter the workflow, not only the information content. These observations motivate measuring diagnostic opportunity cost; they do not show diagnostics are generally useless or isolate our trace intervention. No claim of statistical equivalence is imported.

novelty_status: Not established. Do not describe prospective acquisition or costed testing itself as a new method.
future_comparison_requirement: Only after repeated solver and intervention usefulness: compare a pre-acquisition calibrated expected-value baseline, best fixed rule, static fact-selection rule and selector on untouched grouped bugs, charging all acquisition and selection resources.
